interface.shortDescription: Deploy and operate AWS infrastructure with Ravion.
interface.longDescription: Use Ravion from Codex to deploy applications to your own AWS account: connect an AWS account and Git repository, define projects, environments, and modules in a ravion.yaml project config file, review Terraform plans and approve stack runs, build and deploy code through pipelines, inspect logs and metrics, and roll back.
